author: ArkhamJoshFTW
body:
A week ago about i cursed (only once or twice) at SpicyTunaRoll9 for him being annoying because me and someone were talking about something and it was just really annoying. (The chat we were in was 18+ though.) So then he tells me i have bad "Behavior" and told me he would get me banned. But that's not all... he said that in a public chat with a bunch of people. (Also, he cursed at me while telling me he would get me banned.) If i had to guess how many people were there i would guess 10 or more. It was very humiliating and insulting. Here is something he said that i remember:

"Were all getting tired of your shit" 

No one though really cared that i cursed because it's 18+

Thank you for your time avicus staff and i wish you all the best,
                                               -CrocRock123
